sources.title: Kushtrim/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B-Albanian · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3-ASR-.6B Albanian This is a fine-tuned variant of Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-.6B for Albanian (sq / Shqip) automatic speech recognition. It is trained on ~550 hours of carefully curated Albanian audio + transcripts. Intended use ASR / transcription for Albanian speech (general-purpose). Works best on clean speech audio (mono, 16 kHz) with transcripts matching the dataset conventions. Limitations ...

sources.title: Qwen3 ASR 0.6B Albanian - a Hugging Face Space by Kushtrim
sources.snippet: This fine-tuned Whisper model provides reliable transcription for Albanian audio, whether from a microphone or an uploaded file. Key details about this project: Fine-tuned on 550 plus hours of carefully curated Albanian audio data. Hosted on Hugging Face. Repository: Kushtrim/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B-Albanian.
